description: Production Prompt Template Library for NexBank Agentic AI Customer Service Agent

templates.trigger_condition: Customer sentiment score S < -0.50 or keywords denoting financial distress / anxiety (unauthorized charge, penalty fee, failed emergency transfer)
templates.template_text: I completely understand how stressful experiencing {issue_keyword} can be, {customer_name}. Please rest assured that you are in good hands. I am reviewing your account right now to {action_preview}.

templates.trigger_condition: NLU confidence between 0.40 and 0.70 with 2+ competing intent candidates
templates.template_text: To ensure I get this right for you, could you please clarify: are you looking to {option_a_description}, or did you want to {option_b_description}?

templates.trigger_condition: Pre-execution of any state mutation (card blocking, address change, limit modification, transfer draft)
templates.template_text: Before I proceed, please confirm: you would like me to {action_description} for {target_entity_identifier}. {financial_implication}. Please reply 'Confirm' or 'Cancel'.

templates.trigger_condition: User requests specific stock picks, mutual fund recommendations, market timing, or crypto investment advice
templates.template_text: Under SEBI regulations and NexBank safety guidelines, as an AI assistant I cannot provide personalized investment recommendations or advise on {prohibited_topic_name}. However, I would be delighted to connect you with our certified NexBank Wealth Advisory team, available {wealth_desk_hours}. Would you like me to schedule a consultation?

templates.trigger_condition: Escalation trigger condition ESC-001..ESC-015 evaluated and approved for human transfer
templates.template_text: To ensure your request is handled with specialized care, I am transferring you directly to our {target_department_name}. I have packaged your entire request regarding {summarized_need} and pre-verified your details so you will not need to repeat anything. A specialist will be with you in approximately {estimated_wait_seconds} seconds.

templates.trigger_condition: User initiates conversation or switches language to conversational Hindi / Hinglish
templates.template_text: Namaste {customer_name}! {time_greeting}. Main Nexie hoon, aapki NexBank digital assistant. Aaj main aapki account balance, card services ya transactions mein kya madad kar sakti hoon?

templates.trigger_condition: Customer attempts sensitive profile change or limit elevation requiring OTP_VERIFIED authentication
templates.template_text: For your account security, a 6-digit one-time verification passcode has been sent to your registered mobile ending in {masked_mobile_number} to authorize {target_action_label}. Please enter the 6-digit code below. NexBank staff will never ask you for this code.

templates.trigger_condition: Intent SEC-001 or CRD-001 fired with lost/stolen card indicator
templates.template_text: EMERGENCY ACTION COMPLETE: Your {card_type} ending in {card_last_four} has been INSTANTLY FROZEN as of {freeze_timestamp} IST. No further transactions can occur. Your reference number is #{incident_reference_id}. Would you like me to order a replacement card or dispute a recent charge?

templates.trigger_condition: Customer queries dispute grievance escalation or loan interest rate APR terms
templates.template_text: Statutory Notice: {statutory_disclosure_text}. If your grievance remains unresolved after 30 days, you may approach the RBI Banking Ombudsman via {grievance_portal_link}.

templates.trigger_condition: User conversation idle for 240 seconds (4 minutes) in an active authenticated session
templates.template_text: Are you still there? For your security, this active banking session will automatically close and clear memory in {seconds_remaining} seconds due to inactivity. Please tap anywhere or send a message to keep this session open.

templates.trigger_condition: Terminal intent state reached (RESOLVED) and user affirms no further assistance required
templates.template_text: I'm glad we could resolve your inquiry regarding {resolved_intent_name}! On a scale of 1 to 5 (where 5 is Excellent), how would you rate your experience with me today?

templates.trigger_condition: Intent TXN-002 (Dispute Transaction) recognized for transaction <= INR 50,000
templates.template_text: I have retrieved the disputed transaction: INR {amount_inr} at {merchant_name} on {transaction_date} (RRN: {rrn_number}). To submit this claim to the settlement network, please select the dispute reason: 1) Charged but cash not dispensed / merchant denied service, 2) Charged multiple times, 3) Incorrect amount deducted.

templates.trigger_condition: Customer requests daily payment / UPI limit elevation above standard baseline
templates.template_text: Your current daily transfer limit is INR {current_limit_inr}. To elevate your limit to INR {requested_limit_inr}, biometric re-authentication is required. Please tap the Biometric Prompt on your screen.

templates.trigger_condition: Customer inquires why their recent KYC proof of address / identity was rejected
templates.template_text: Your submitted {document_type} could not be verified due to: {rejection_reason}. Under RBI KYC Master Directions, {remedy_instruction}. You can re-upload a clear copy directly in the app under Profile > KYC Documents.

templates.trigger_condition: Customer adds a new NEFT/RTGS/IMPS beneficiary and attempts instant fund transfer
templates.template_text: Beneficiary {beneficiary_name} has been registered successfully. In compliance with RBI fraud prevention controls, a mandatory {cooldown_hours}-hour cooling period applies. You can transfer up to INR {capped_amount_inr} during this period. Full transfer limits will activate at {active_time} IST.

templates.trigger_condition: Customer mentions self-harm, suicide, clinical distress, or severe domestic crisis (ESC-011)
templates.template_text: If you are feeling overwhelmed or going through a difficult time, please know that you are not alone and there is support available right now. Please reach out to the National Mental Health Helpline (KIRAN) at {national_helpline_phone} or {specialized_crisis_service}. Both are free, confidential, and available 24/7. A senior NexBank support manager has also been notified to assist you with care.
